title: deprecated CertChainError variants lack forward-compat doc
description: smime-tree/src/error.rs: CertChainError::AllTrustAnchorsExpired and PathLenViolated are #[deprecated] with note 'never produced by current validator'. They exist in a #[non_exhaustive] public enum for deserialization compat. Missing doc explaining they exist only for forward-compat with serialized data from older versions. Callers are confused about whether to handle them.
